ctaHeading: CPG Plumbers: Your Preston Plumbing Solution
aboutText: At CPG Plumbers in Preston, we go beyond the ordinary to ensure your complete satisfaction. Our team of qualified and experienced plumbers is dedicated to handling all your plumbing needs, from emergencies to regular maintenance. Serving Metropolitan Melbourne with pride, we are committed to delivering outstanding service every time.
servicesSubheading: Expert Solutions for Every Plumbing Need
servicesText: From gas fitting and hot water installations to blocked drain repairs and excavation work, CPG Plumbers covers all aspects of plumbing. Our services are tailored for both residential and commercial clients in Preston and across Melbourne.

services.title: Gas Fitting & Heating
services.desc: Our certified gas fitters handle all gas appliance installations, repairs, and safety inspections for heating and hot water systems in Preston.

services.title: Water Services
services.desc: Expert water supply solutions including burst pipe repairs, rainwater tank installations, and complete plumbing refurbishments for homes and businesses.

services.title: Drainage Solutions
services.desc: Specialists in clearing blocked drains, stormwater systems, and sewerage repairs to keep properties in Preston flowing smoothly.

services.title: Excavation & New Developments
services.desc: Comprehensive excavation services for new construction projects, site preparation, and underground plumbing installations across Melbourne.

services.title: Maintenance & Roofing
services.desc: Routine plumbing maintenance, roof leak repairs, guttering services, and general upkeep to prevent future issues for Preston residents.

services.title: Residential & Commercial Plumbing
services.desc: Tailored plumbing solutions for homes and businesses, including bathroom renovations, strata services, and full refurbishments in Preston.
